### Core Analysis Summary

1. **Chassis Architecture:**
   - **Root Module ([app.module.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/app.module.ts)):** Imports the spread `...MODULES` array exported by the model-owned module index ([index.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/modules/index.ts)) and registers [HealthController](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/platform/health.controller.ts#L11).
   - **Health Endpoint ([health.controller.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/platform/health.controller.ts)):** Maps `GET /health` to return a snapshot containing the scaffold version, ID, and `modules_registered` (which evaluates `MODULES.length`).
   - **Module Registration Slot ([index.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/modules/index.ts)):** Clean list initialized to `export const MODULES: any[] = [];`.
   - **Bootstrapper ([main.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/main.ts)):** Fires the [bootstrap](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/main.ts#L12) logic listening on the mapped environment [PORT](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/platform/config.ts#L7) with clean, minimal log-levels (`warn` / `error`).

2. **Database Engine & ORM ([schema.prisma](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/prisma/schema.prisma)):**
   - Configures SQLite datasource writing to the local `./dev.db` file.
   - Includes standard system sanity structure `AppMeta` table.
   - Defines a explicit domain-insertion point on the bottom (`// ═══ MODEL SLOT — generated domain models are appended below ═══`).

3. **Testing Engine ([chassis.test.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/test/platform/chassis.test.ts)):**
   - Implements Vitest test definitions (`describe`, `it`, `expect`) targeting basic integrity checks: Health contract schema, module-slot type, and port range.

### Kudos Wall Recommended Design Architecture

1. **Domain Schema:** Append a database `model Kudos` under the schema's model slot:
   - `id`: `Int @id @default(autoincrement())` (Database internal reference)
   - `sender`: `String` (Appreciating agent - FR-1, FR-3)
   - `recipient`: `String` (Receiving agent - FR-1, FR-3)
   - `message`: `String` (Text of appraisal - FR-1, FR-3)
   - `createdAt`: `DateTime @default(now())` (Sorting metric - FR-3)
2. **Kudos Module Scope:** Design locally scoped files under `src/modules/kudos/`:
   - `prisma.service.ts`: Injectable Prisma wrapper extending `PrismaClient` with connection hooks.
   - `kudos.service.ts`: Exposes direct query bindings for creating records and retrieving sorted listings.
   - `kudos.controller.ts`: Direct controller exposing `POST /kudos` and `GET /kudos`. Excludes heavy dependencies like `class-validator` in favor of streamlined, manual parameter shape validations returning `BadRequestException`.
   - `kudos.module.ts`: Declares controllers & providers to register with standard dependency injection.
3. **Registration:** Wire the module imports directly into [index.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T21-49-28/workdir/src/modules/index.ts):
   ```typescript
   import { KudosModule } from "./kudos/kudos.module";
   export const MODULES = [KudosModule];
   ```
4. **Validation Routine:** Fast programmatic type & length checks directly on the incoming body parser:
   ```typescript
   if (typeof sender !== "string" || !sender.trim()) throw new BadRequestException(...);
   ```
5. **Testing Layout:** Run integration suites inside `test/modules/kudos.test.ts` wrapping execution in NestJS `Test.createTestingModule` utilizing Vitest.

All of the configuration analysis matches standard design pattern rules cleanly with no file mutation or creation. Let me know if you would like me to transition into the model development or next stage!
